Strong knowledge of pipeline construction methodologies, welding, NDT, coatings, hydrotesting, Horizontal Directional Drilling (HDD) for HDPE and ductile iron pipeline commissioning. Experience with water pipeline, road, rail, river and utility crossings is highly desirable. Strong understanding of project controls, contracts, cost management and construction planning. Experience in managing EPC contractors and subcontractors. Strong leadership, communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills. Preferred Attributes Strong commercial and contractual awareness. Experience with major oil & gas, water, slurry, gas, crude or product pipeline projects. Familiarity with international pipeline codes and standards such as ASME B31.4/B31.8, API and applicable local regulations. Ability to operate effectively in remote locations and challenging construction environments. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams and deliver projects under demanding schedule and operational constraints. Engineering & Design Coordinate with EPC contractor and design teams to ensure timely completion of detailed engineering. Review and resolve design, constructability and technical issues. Ensure alignment between pipeline design, hydraulic requirements, crossings, terminals, pumping facilities and associated infrastructure. Promote constructability reviews and value-engineering initiatives. Procurement & Contracts Coordinate procurement of pipes, valves, fittings, specialty items and other long-lead materials. Monitor vendor performance, manufacturing schedules, inspections and delivery to site. Manage EPC, construction and specialist contractors in accordance with agreed scope & contractual requirements. Review variations, claims, extensions of time and other contractual matters. Construction Management Oversee pipeline construction activities: Surveying and route preparation Right-of-way preparation Clearing and grading Trenching and excavation Stringing, bending and welding NDT and weld inspection Field joint coating Lowering-in and backfilling Hydrotesting Reinstatement and restoration Crossings of roads, railways, rivers and other utilities Ensure construction activities are properly sequenced and coordinated across multiple work fronts. Monitor productivity, manpower, equipment utilisation and contractor performance inline with project schedule. HSE & Quality Maintain the company Policy & standards of health, safety and environmental performance throughout the project. Ensure compliance with applicable legislation, codes, standards, permits and project requirements. Establish and monitor project quality plans, inspection and test plans and quality assurance systems. Drive a strong safety culture across employees, contractors and subcontractors. Schedule & Cost Control Establish and maintain the integrated project schedule. Monitor progress against key milestones and identify potential delays at an early stage. Review project costs, commitments, forecasts and cash flow on monthly basis . Implement recovery plans where schedule or cost performance deviates from the approved baseline. Identifing critical path and mitigation plan. Stakeholder Management Manage relationships with the client, government authorities, landowners, local communities, consultants, contractors and other stakeholders. Coordinate statutory approvals, permits, right-of-way requirements and third-party interfaces. Resolve conflicts and facilitate timely decision-making on project-critical matters. Ensure completion of hydrotesting, cleaning, gauging, drying and associated pipeline integrity activities. Ensure all documentation, as-built drawings, test records, inspection dossiers and handover documentation are completed. Coordinate final acceptance and project close-out.
